items.text: Hartwell Primary has 240 pupils on roll this year.

The fair budget approved by the governing board is 800 pounds.
Local shops on Bridge Street have pledged raffle prizes worth about 250 pounds for the fair.
The staff training day this autumn is Friday 23 October 2026.
The council requires a parking permit for any weekend event using the sports hall car park.

Switch the school uniform contract to Cornwell Uniforms from January 2027, after two quotes were collected.
Print 300 A5 fair flyers with Riverside Print, each showing the fair date, at a cost of 95 pounds from the fair budget.

The Friends of Hartwell quiz night will be Friday 20 November 2026 in the school hall, with tickets at 6 pounds.
Price raffle tickets at 1 pound each and print 500 tickets from the prizes already pledged.
Sell quiz night tickets through the school office from mid-October, with proceeds to the library fund.
Bell Family Tents quoted 340 pounds to put up a 6-by-12-metre marquee on the school field for fair day.
Submit the fire-risk assessment form to the council for the autumn events. Done on 25 August.
Apply for the sports hall car park parking permit covering both the fair and the quiz night.
The school kitchen is being repainted during the October half-term break.
Confirm the marquee booking with Bell Family Tents by paying the 85-pound deposit and stating the fair date in writing. Not done yet.
The school minibus lease renews on 1 April 2027 at 420 pounds a month.
Circulate the finished fair poster artwork to Bridge Street shops. Not done yet.
